scope: Gate 7 bounded search after initial validation results; no calibration/test scoring
selection: Lowest validation MAE per family; exact ties use listed configuration order. Prefer Ridge if its relative MAE gap from the best family is strictly below 1%; otherwise choose lowest MAE.
diagnostics: Train target p95 defines high load; train p95 of positive next-hour minus last-hour change defines large rises. Future changes are retrospective diagnostics, never inputs.
latency: First 256 validation rows in chronological order, one predict call per row after one warmup; model-only timing, no feature generation or UI.
